_: The design system, as far as the model is concerned. It never sees CSS, tokens or markup — only this. Four kinds of statement: permissions (what MAY appear), obligations (what MUST), assemblies (what moves as one unit), and the content contract in slots. Read from disk on every request, never bundled — this file is edited live on stage.
invariants: SiteChrome is always present and always in the same position.
Search is always reachable without scrolling.
The reasoning sentence, when shown, is always in the same location.
No composition may omit every means of reaching a full recipe.
Type scale, colour and spacing are fixed. The model selects and orders blocks. It never styles them.

components.name: TechniqueThread
components.intent: Every attempt at one technique, in order, with what changed each time and the one variable not yet tried. For someone who repeats dishes to learn rather than to eat.

slots.requires: entries: at least 3 recipeIds, all sharing one technique tag, each cooked on a separate occasion. Also set techniqueTag.

components.name: ComparisonTable
components.intent: Three to five dishes compared on axes chosen for this household. Use when the user is choosing rather than reading.

slots.requires: rows: 3 to 5 recipeIds. axes: 2 to 4, chosen for this household, never a filter UI's columns. Also set emphasis.

components.name: RecipeCard
components.intent: A single dish presented for selection. The workhorse.

slots.requires: recipe: exactly 1 recipeId. Use "hero" for the one dish this page is about — it takes the whole top of the page and claims the page's single Display XL, so a page with a hero may not also run TechniqueThread at full.

components.name: ForkedRecipeCard
components.intent: A dish that splits partway to serve two constraints at one table. The split is drawn, not described.

slots.requires: recipe: exactly 1 recipeId, and it must be one that forks.

components.name: WhyThisWorks
components.intent: The principle several dishes share. The most editorial block in the system.

slots.requires: recipes: at least 3 recipeIds sharing one technique tag. Also set techniqueTag.

components.name: SkillPrimer
components.intent: A fundamentals explainer on one technique.

slots.requires: techniqueTag: exactly one technique tag the user has attempted.

components.name: TroubleshootingList
components.intent: The ways this dish goes wrong. A description of a pan, never an alert.

components.name: PrepSchedule
components.intent: Work sequenced across days when several dishes share a base. The shared base is the reason the block exists.

slots.requires: days: at least 2 recipeIds that have make-ahead steps.

components.name: ShoppingList
components.intent: Buying, grouped by store section, in the order you walk it.

slots.requires: sections: at least 2 recipeIds you are planning together.

components.name: PantryMatch
components.intent: Starting from what is in the house rather than from a dish. The gap matters as much as the matches.

slots.requires: matches: 2 to 4 recipeIds, or leave empty to rank the whole corpus.

components.name: TonightShortlist
components.intent: Choosing among two to four dishes when deciding what to cook now.

components.name: MakeAheadCallout
components.intent: The step that can be done in advance, surfaced for someone who works that way.

slots.requires: step: exactly 1 recipeId that has a make-ahead step.

components.name: SubstitutionTable
components.intent: The gap between what a dish wants and what is available.

slots.requires: rows: exactly 1 recipeId — the dish with the gap.
recipe: exactly 1 recipeId yielding more than the household size.

components.name: FromYourHistory
components.intent: A callback to something they made before.

slots.requires: recipe: exactly 1 recipeId the user has cooked more than once.

components.name: SeasonalNote
components.intent: One line tying tonight to the time of year.

obligations.name: AllergenNotice
obligations.intent: Declaring an allergen present in a dish on this page.

locked.placement: immediately before the first block mentioning that recipe
